elsewhere.note: When midday was past, they prophesied until the time of the evening offering; but there was no voice, no answer, and nobody paid attention.
Gehazi went ahead of them, and laid the staff on the child’s face; but there was no voice and no hearing. Therefore he returned to meet him, and told him, “The…
When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”
